traditional: No classical doctrine: Uranus is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Action meets disruption. Impulsive, risk-taking, rebellious energy, with impatience and a pull toward technology. The sextile makes this a natural strength: Quick, original action and inventive problem-solving. The growth edge is not to coast on the ease.

cyclic.waxing: A chance to organize drive and disruption into a new form; it must be actively taken up.
cyclic.waning: Reorganize and share what drive and disruption have taught; communicate the insight.

business: An opening in this area. Innovative and fast; the cost is recklessness and volatility.
shadow: The ease lets anger and recklessness and instability for its own sake go unchecked, or the opening pass unused.
arcApplying: A supportive opening becomes available; offered, not automatic.
arcSeparating: The opening closes; unused, it passes.

readerCopy.summary: A problem you have been handling the same way for months may suddenly have a much easier solution once you notice the part of the routine that never needed to be there.
readerCopy.body: A problem you have been handling the same way for months may suddenly have a much easier solution once you notice the part of the routine that never needed to be there. When Mars sextiles Uranus, you are more willing to recognize and act on the workaround, tool, different route, or unconventional idea that gets you past a recurring source of friction. The new option does not have to replace everything you already know; it only needs to solve the part that keeps wasting your time. Do not retreat to the old method just because the new one feels unfamiliar. If it removes the bottleneck, let that be enough signal to change course.
